subject: Make several radioButtons(different labels) exclusive to each other

messages.author: 4421a3e16a8bc021
messages.subject: Make several radioButtons(different labels) exclusive to each other
parts:
Hi All,

I'm trying to build something like this:

shinyUI(fluidPage(
             
            radioButtons("segment", label = h4("Direct New"),
                         choices = list("ODC" = "Direct New ODC", "ODO" = "Direct New ODO", "ODV" = "Direct New ODV","STD"="Direct New STD")
                         ,selected = NULL),
            hr(),
            radioButtons("segment", label = h4("FAP New"),
                         choices = list("EPQ" = "FAP New EPQ", "ODC" = "FAP New ODC")
                         ),
            hr(),
            radioButtons("segment", label = h4("Renewals"),
                         choices = list("ODC" = "All Renew ODC", "ODO" = "All Renew ODO", "ODV" = "All Renew ODV","STD"="All Renew STD")),
)
)

The idea is to segment a list of options and call out the group name(Direct New, FAP New, Renewals). I hope the user only select one option from the entire list regardless of the group. So I give the three sets of radioButtons the same name, in which way the selection is unique. However, Shiny won't switch between different sets of radioButtions with same name. For example, if I print(input$segment), it will always gives me the value in the first set even though I select something from the second and third sets.

Is there anyway to achieve what I want?
